contract.solver: direct ordered all-pairs O(N^2) leapfrog kick-drift-kick with one retained acceleration field
contract.floatingPointPolicy: IEEE-754 f64, source-order scalar operations, no fast-math, no SIMD, no fused multiply-add
contract.stateLayout: seven structure-of-arrays f64 vectors in order mass, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz

targets.semanticWork: Authored JavaScript performs fixture decoding, all 126,753,792 ordered interactions as frozen by the exact counter, every leapfrog update, checkpoint capture and energy oracle.
Authored C compiled to fixed-memory linear Wasm independently performs all force and leapfrog work and writes the complete state/checkpoint result; JavaScript only copies input and decodes output.
